5 min to hand in (the previous quests take many hours)

The {wiki:Warmaster Outfits|Warmaster Outfit} is earned by completing {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}. You get the two addons (Nobori and Kabuto) from the sage {npc:Cael}, in Farmine, in exchange for the crests obtained in Zao's big quests: the {item:Serpent Crest} and the {item:Tribal Crest}. With both addons you get the achievement **Master of War**.
Nobori addon: complete the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest} (gives the {item:Serpent Crest}).
Kabuto addon: complete the {wiki:Unnatural Selection Quest} (gives the {item:Tribal Crest}).
{wiki:Warmaster Outfits|Warmaster Outfit} (on completing The New Frontier Quest)
The dangers listed come from the prerequisite quests in Zao (including orcs of all kinds and the bosses of the {wiki:Chazorai|Island of Strife}). Handing the crests to Cael is not dangerous at all.
Complete {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} to receive the {wiki:Warmaster Outfits|Warmaster Outfit}.

Farmine is underground in Zao. Go to **Kazordoon**, go down to the underground {wiki:Steamship} harbour and talk to {npc:Brodrosch}: say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Farmine's harbour, next to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}). {npc:Cael} is **north** of the steamship and the armoury, a few floors up ({coord:33028,31513,10}).
Handing the Serpent Crest to Cael
Go to **Farmine** and talk to {npc:Cael}, who is **north** of {npc:Ongulf}. Say {key:hello}, {key:crest} and {key:yes}.
Male Warmaster with the Nobori addon
Female Warmaster with the Nobori addon
Handing the Tribal Crest to Cael
Go back to {npc:Cael} in Farmine and say {key:hello}, {key:crest} and {key:yes}.
Male Warmaster with the Kabuto addon
Female Warmaster with the Kabuto addon
After you hand in **both** crests (Serpent Crest and Tribal Crest) you have the complete Warmaster Outfit and receive the achievement **Master of War**.
To go back, go down to the steamship and talk to {npc:Thorgrin}: say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} to return to Kazordoon's underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.
